Add a caveat that suitability and oversight requirements are case-specific, then add a quote checklist for scans, attachments, refinements, retainers, follow-ups, insurance lifetime orthodontic maximums, and financing APR. Include a short prompt directing readers to obtain comparable itemized estimates before choosing a provider.
